mapper.select: select n.id, n.actor_uuid as actorUuid, u.nickname as actorNickname, n.entity_type as entityType, n.entity_id as entityId, case when n.entity_type = 'POST' then coalesce(nullif(substring(p.title, 1, 30), ''), 'post') when n.entity_type = 'COMMENT' then coalesce(nullif(substring(c.content, 1, 30), ''), 'comment') when n.entity_type = 'REPLY' then coalesce(nullif(substring(r.content, 1, 30), ''), 'reply') else '' end as entityPreview, n.is_read as isRead, n.created_at as createdAt from like_notification n left join user u on u.uuid = n.actor_uuid left join post p on n.entity_type = 'POST' and p.id = n.entity_id left join post_comment c on n.entity_type = 'COMMENT' and c.id = n.entity_id left join comment_reply r on n.entity_type = 'REPLY' and r.id = n.entity_id where n.receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} order by n.created_at desc
mapper.update: update like_notification set is_read = 1, read_at = now(), updated_at = now() where receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} and is_read = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from like_notification where receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} and is_read = 0
